withdrawn_metric.name: lifetime-derived active route absence
withdrawn_metric.reason: updateValidRouteLifeTime extends route lifetime without logRouteCauseEvent; previously inferred expiry times are incomplete

limitations: Observed conditions are exploratory associations, not a verified causal intervention.
CBP and observed station counts depend on traffic as well as geometry.
The summary statistics retain all 450 paired result conditions; detailed comparisons require identical position-log signatures.
A zero-CBP tail is based on one-second radio observations and is not a physical disconnection count.
Three improved Q4 cases also have a longer zero-CBP tail, so it is not a sufficient condition.

trace_validation.method: Request-generation cohorts; delivered means unique nonduplicate reply, consistent with result.txt; conservative tail begins two seconds after final positive network CBP snapshot.
